conviction_note: Small positive lean: the one new thing at this print is that the Fed hiked on 2026-09-16, three months before the single December hike in Schwab's July scenario, so the Q4 NIM / 2027 outlook should be raised, while the peer cash data for September (MS higher average sweep deposits, IBKR credit balances flat) argue against the cash-sorting fear behind the -9% 20-day slide; but this name sold its last two record beats (Q1 -0.37%, Q2 about -2.5% the next day), consensus EPS was trimmed rather than raised after the hike, and DATs look slightly light, so p_up is only 56 on a 3.5% absolute move (+0.42) against a findings sum of +1.4. The gap between the two is the reaction-function veto, not a contradiction.
bar: Q3 2026 adjusted EPS $1.66 and revenue $7.19B (Zacks via Yahoo, https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/robust-trading-higher-nir-support-134100585.html), with $1.67 / $7.21B on Benzinga (https://www.benzinga.com/analyst-stock-ratings/price-target/26/10/62155786/charles-schwab-gears-up-for-q3-print-here-are-the-recent-forecast-changes-from-wall-streets-most-accura, snippet only: 403), and 'just under $7.2B' / $1.66 per Motley Fool 2026-10-13 (https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/10/13/charles-schwab-s-next-earnings-report-on-oct-15-2026-could-send-the-stock-soaring-here-s-why/). Two agreeing sources, so the bar is usable. Line items (Zacks): net interest revenue $3.57B (Q2 actual $3,357M per 10-Q), asset management fees $1.89B, trading revenue $1.18B, DATs 10.48M, avg interest-earning assets $460.6B, total client assets $13.35T. Company guide (Q2 call, 2026-07-21): FY26 revenue +17.5-18.5%, FY NIM 3.00-3.10%, Q4 NIM 3.25-3.30%, expense growth 9.5-10.5%, scenario assumes ONE 25bp hike in December 2026 and no opportunistic 2H26 buybacks. Zacks says EPS consensus was revised marginally lower over the last 30 days and its ESP is -0.11%.
positioning_check: Short interest about 16.9M shares (roughly 1% of float), 2.5 days to cover at the 2026-08-14 settlement, down from about 25.0M (1.85 days) at 2026-06-30 (https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/schw/short-interest/, https://kr.benzinga.com/quote/SCHW/short-interest); no October settlement found. Not a crowded short. Baseline 25-delta skew -0.07 vol points (flat; priced_direction_lean 'balanced'), put/call OI 0.89, event-implied move 3.78% (straddle 4.08% to the 10-16 expiry; unusualwhales shows +/-3.36% as of 10-14). Tape: spot 95.60, -9.09% over 20 days, -15.9% from the 52-week high, flat over 5 days; the 2026-09-22 leg (-6.1% to $100.35) was the Meta Muse AI-disruption selloff across brokers/wealth names, and financials were the worst S&P sector in September (-6%).

findings.finding: The Fed raised rates 25bp to 3.75-4.00% on 2026-09-16 with the SEP pointing to more, whereas Schwab's July 2026 scenario (Q4 NIM 3.25-3.30%, FY NIM 3.00-3.10%) assumed a single 25bp hike in December; Schwab is asset-sensitive (bank deposits cost 0.19% in Q2, sweep pays ~0.01%) and a 25bp move is cited at roughly $250-300M of annualized NII, so the Fall Business Update should lift the Q4 NIM exit rate and the 2027 NII path by something on the order of $250-300M annualized (~1% of FY26 revenue guide of ~$28.1-28.4B).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 (2026-07-21): revenue beat 3.8%, EPS beat ~7%, FY revenue guide raised and operating leverage guided to 800bp from 400bp; stock fell ~3% premarket on a BMO downgrade and -2.52% next day per unusualwhales, then rallied to an all-time high $109.05 over the following weeks. Q1 2026: record quarter, -0.37% on the day (TIKR). Guidance raises have paid with a lag rather than on the day.
findings.why_not_priced: If the market had priced an earlier-than-modelled hike as NII upside, consensus EPS would have been revised up after 09-16; instead Zacks reports it revised marginally lower over 30 days, and the stock is -9% over 20 days with brokers selling off after the hike on cash-sorting fear (TIKR). The rate move is public; Schwab's re-based outlook is not.
findings.independence: Fed decision: https://capitalandcompute.net/blog/federal-reserve-interest-rates-september-2026/ (hike to 3.75-4.00%, first since 2023). Sensitivity and post-hike broker selloff: https://www.tikr.com/blog/charles-schwab-stock-fell-6-on-ai-fears-the-rate-hike-everyone-feared-actually-helps-it (2026-09-23, secondary source for the $250-300M figure). Deposit cost 0.19% from the Q2 10-Q https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000316709/000031670926000031/schw-20260630.htm. Caveat built into the size: the hike affects only two weeks of Q3, and the same hike raises the cash-sorting incentive (finding 2).

findings.finding: September cash data from counterparties shows no post-hike cash-sorting run: Morgan Stanley's Q3 release (2026-10-14) says Wealth Management NII rose 12% y/y to $2,228M on lending growth and 'higher average sweep deposits'; Interactive Brokers' September credit balances were $186.2B, roughly flat vs August and +20% y/y; Schwab's own transactional sweep cash went $485.7B (June) -> $476.8B (July, -$8.9B) -> $483.3B (August, +$6.5B). Schwab's September sweep level is unpublished and arrives with the print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Sweep cash is the line the 2023 drawdown traded on; in 2026 it rose $24.2B in Q2 and management said underlying cash was 'performing better than initial expectations', and the stock still fell on the Q2 print day. No clean single-line reaction available.
findings.why_not_priced: The stock's 20-day -9% and the post-hike broker selloff price the risk that September sweep balances fell as rates rose (Fool preview names cash sorting as the main risk). If peers' September data had been read through, the drawdown would have partly reversed on 10-14 after MS printed; spot is flat over 5 days.
findings.independence: IBKR September metrics https://www.financemagnates.com/forex/interactive-brokers-reports-56m-client-accounts-in-september-darts-at-41m/ (2026-10-01); Schwab August monthly https://www.financialcontent.com/article/bizwire-2026-9-15-schwab-reports-monthly-activity-highlights (2026-09-15). These are peers/proxies, not Schwab's September number; IBKR's base is active traders and MS's is advisory, so transmission is partial.

findings.finding: Trading activity tracks slightly below the bar: Schwab DATs were 11.6M in July and 9.8M in August (-16% m/m); consensus Q3 DATs are 10.48M, which needs September at ~10.0M or more, while Interactive Brokers' September DARTs fell ~4% from August, pointing to a Schwab September near 9.4-9.6M and a Q3 average around 10.3M (~2% light); on the $1.18B trading revenue consensus that is a ~$20-30M gap, under 0.5% of revenue.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Schwab's guide already embeds 'an expected pullback from recent monthly levels' (FY DATs 10.6M); trading revenue is ~17% of revenue and has not been the line the stock reacted to in 2026.
findings.why_not_priced: The consensus DAT figure (10.48M) sits above what July+August plus a peer-implied September produce; if the IBKR September read had been folded in, the estimate would be nearer 10.3M.
findings.independence: IBKR September DARTs -4% m/m: https://finviz.com/news/397937/interactive-brokers-group-reports-brokerage-metrics-and-other-financial-information-for-september-2026-includes-reg-nms-execution-statistics (2026-10-01). Consensus DATs: https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/exploring-analyst-estimates-charles-schwab-121503932.html. Revenue-per-trade guided to rise modestly, which offsets part of it.

findings.finding: Balance-sheet and asset inputs run at or above the bar: core NNA was a record $58.1B in July and $64.8B in August, total client assets $13.41T at August end against a $13.35T Q3-end consensus (S&P 500 -0.5% in September), margin balances $177.6B at August end (+58% YTD), and bank loans $67.0B at June (+33% y/y); Schwab raised ~$5.8B of senior notes May-August 2026 to fund that loan/margin growth, consistent with average interest-earning assets above Q2's.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Record NNA and client growth have printed every quarter of 2026 and the stock fell on both print days (Q1 -0.37%, Q2 ~-2.5% next day): this name has not paid on the day for asset-gathering beats.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the monthly reports are public and consensus has had them. The residual is that consensus client assets ($13.35T) sits below the August level with September NNA still to add, and EPS consensus was trimmed rather than raised.
findings.independence: Q2 10-Q (receivables $122.8B, bank loans $67.0B, other short-term borrowings up) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000316709/000031670926000031/schw-20260630.htm; notes issuance https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000316709/000119312526347083/d42452d8k.htm; S&P September https://political.org/2026/09/30/beneath-a-near-record-sp-500-three-quarters-of-its-stocks-quietly-had-a-losing-september/. Shares the monthly-report document with finding 3.

findings.finding: Capital return optionality: the July scenario excluded opportunistic buybacks in 2H26 (Q1 $2.4B, Q2 $1.0B, H1 $3.4B), with adjusted Tier 1 leverage at 6.8% inside the 6.75-7.00% target; with the stock now ~16% below its high and the balance sheet growing, any resumed or re-authorized repurchase announced at the update would be outside the scenario.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No clean history; buybacks were part of the Q1/Q2 prints, neither of which rose on the day.
findings.why_not_priced: Inference only: nothing says Schwab bought stock in Q3; consensus built on the company scenario of no 2H buybacks would carry none. The leverage ratio near the low end of target and the debt-funded balance-sheet growth argue capital is being kept for loans, which is why this is sized tiny.
findings.independence: Q2 call guidance excluding 2H26 opportunistic repurchases: https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/07/21/schwab-schw-q2-2026-earnings-call-transcript/. No document confirms a resumption.

findings.finding: The 20-day -9.1% drawdown into the print was driven by a sector-wide AI-disruption scare (Meta Muse, 2026-09-22, Schwab -6.1% to $100.35, LPL -7%, financials -2%) and the financials' -6% September, not by Schwab-specific data; the release and 8:30 ET business update give management a platform to answer it with Q3 NNA and account-growth records, against a bar that was trimmed into the print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026: a strong print against a stock 'riding fairly high' after stress tests fell on the day; this time the setup is the reverse (stock 16% off the high, flat skew), which has no direct precedent in the 2026 prints.
findings.why_not_priced: The overhang is fully visible in the price; what is not priced is whether management's answer lands. The size is small because an AI-disruption narrative is not refuted by one quarter's numbers, and the same fear (software moving idle cash, e.g. JPMorgan's AI cash tool) bears directly on sweep economics.
findings.independence: https://www.tikr.com/blog/charles-schwab-stock-fell-6-on-ai-fears-the-rate-hike-everyone-feared-actually-helps-it (2026-09-23); https://www.thestar.com.my/tech/tech-news/2026/09/24/meta039s-muse-rekindles-fears-over-winners-and-losers-as-personal-ai-agent-emerges. Overlaps in mechanism with finding 2 (cash behaviour); kept separate because this one is about the narrative and multiple, finding 2 about the reported balance.
